proposal_independent: The unit will act independently while following these reservations.
name: Movement reservation
summary: Schedule an ordered route, optionally setting speed, altitude or depth for each leg.
requirements: Requires Data for AI access to own units and movement plans. The target must be controllable and mobile; aircraft must be airborne. Settings must be among the target's available options. The first reservation update may switch a follower to independent action.
proposal_followers: Formation followers will follow the leader through the game's formation control.
proposal_settings: Settings apply when travel toward each waypoint starts. Omitted settings remain unchanged.
